//===== NEED Phase 0.33 - runtime verifier + perf harness ===================
//= TEST ONLY. GENERATED by p33_runtime.py. Registers nothing, changes nothing.
//============================================================================

sec_pri,60,60,4	script	NEED Phase33 Perf	-1,{
	end;

OnRun:
	// showscript needs a source with a real map: a floating `-` NPC has m = -1 and an
	// AREA send from it reaches nobody, so it measures nothing.
	freeloop(1);
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { showscript "KR"; }
	.@old = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { showscriptlang "KR", "EN"; }
	.@new = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { showscriptlang "KR", "KR"; }
	.@same = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	freeloop(0);
	debugmes "[P33][PERF] showscript old=" + .@old + "ms pair=" + .@new + "ms same-text=" + .@same + "ms iterations=" + 1000000;
	end;
}

//= a Phase 0.9 REGRESSION WITNESS: an NPC whose name_en is registered and whose
//= showscript message IS its own display name with no '#tag', which is the only
//= shape that makes clif_showscript take the Phase 0.9 branch.
sec_pri,62,60,4	script	P33 Witness	-1,{
	end;

OnInit:
	setnpcnameen "P33 Witness EN", "P33 Witness", 1;
	debugmes "[P33][P09] name_en=" + getnpcnameen() + " nd_name=" + strnpcinfo(1);
	end;

OnFire:
	// no pair given -> clif_showscript decides, and for this NPC the Phase 0.9
	// branch must fire (message == nd->name, name_en set, flag == AREA)
	showscript strnpcinfo(1);
	end;
}

-	script	NEED Phase33 Verify	-1,{
	end;

OnInit:
	debugmes "[P33] ---- verifier start ----";

	// ---- no-RID: showscriptlang must be callable with no attached player ----
	// A needtr() here would always have returned Korean. This call carries BOTH
	// strings and lets each recipient pick, so OnInit / OnTimer / an instance
	// event can serve a mixed KR/EN area correctly.
	showscriptlang "[P33] no-RID KR", "[P33] no-RID EN", getnpcid(0,"NEED Phase33 Perf");
	debugmes "[P33][NORID] showscriptlang returned from OnInit with no attached RID";

	// ---- fallback shapes must not crash and must not broadcast twice ----
	showscriptlang "[P33] empty-EN falls back to KR", "", getnpcid(0,"NEED Phase33 Perf");
	showscriptlang "[P33] identical halves", "[P33] identical halves", getnpcid(0,"NEED Phase33 Perf");
	debugmes "[P33][FALLBACK] empty EN and identical halves both returned";

	donpcevent "P33 Witness::OnFire";
	debugmes "[P33][P09] Phase 0.9 branch exercised via showscript strnpcinfo(1)";

	donpcevent "NEED Phase33 Perf::OnRun";

	debugmes "[P33] ---- verifier done ----";
	bindatcmd "p33", "NEED Phase33 Verify::OnAtP33", 99, 99;
	end;

OnAtP33:
	// Run on ONE client. A working filter shows EXACTLY ONE line per surface.
	//   one line  -> the filter works
	//   two lines -> it failed OPEN (not filtering)
	//   no line   -> it failed CLOSED (rejecting everybody)
	dispbottom "[P33] need_lang=" + getneedlang() + "  (use @needlang 0 / 1)";

	// 1. general text, AREA, above your own character
	showscriptlang "[P33-1] 이 줄은 한국어입니다.", "[P33-1] This line is English.", getcharid(3);

	// 2. general text, AREA, above an NPC (the Geffen shape)
	showscriptlang "[P33-2] NPC 위의 한국어 줄입니다.", "[P33-2] English line above an NPC.", getnpcid(0,"NEED Phase33 Perf");

	// 3. the name-display shape the migrated buff/warper sites now use
	showscriptlang "[P33-3] " + strnpcinfo(1), "[P33-3] " + getnpcnameen("P33 Witness"), getnpcid(0,"P33 Witness");

	// 4. bc_self: single recipient, the caller's own language, ONE send
	showscriptlang "[P33-4 self] 이 줄은 한국어입니다.", "[P33-4 self] This line is English.", getcharid(3), bc_self;

	// 5. empty EN must fall back to KR for EVERY session, EN included
	showscriptlang "[P33-5] empty EN -> KR for everyone", "", getcharid(3);

	// 6. the unchanged single-recipient needtr() path, for comparison
	dispbottom needtr("[P33-6] dispbottom needtr KR", "[P33-6] dispbottom needtr EN");
	end;
}
